rationale: 3D body tracking is intentionally reduced to sparse points of light, preserving recognizable movement while introducing delay and abstraction.
notes: The official page documents Metrilus 3D cameras, custom electronics and LEDs; the work presents a full-length body image as distributed points of light with a slight delay while retaining recognisability.

decision.rationale: Strong physical HCI example of information reduction: identity and movement survive aggressive abstraction, and latency becomes part of the perceptual relationship rather than an implementation flaw.
